product_metadata.title: Towel Bazaar Premium Turkish Cotton Super Soft and Absorbent Towels (4-Piece Bath Towels, Coral)
features: LUXURY HOTEL & SPA QUALITY TOWELS: These towels are made of 100% premium cotton. Turkish towels are known to get even softer, fluffier, and more absorbent with a proper wash. Durably made with highly absorbent, natural friendly 100% premium cotton with double stitched hem for long-lasting use.
CHEMICAL FREE & ECO-FRIENDLY: In our manufacturing process, we use eco-friendly materials to contribute saving our earth.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash in cold water with mild liquid detergent without added bleach or whiteners before use. Tumble dry on low heat or hang them to dry. Please don’t use dry sheets, chemicals will only reduce the softness of the material.
